construct.claim: Given a common coordinate typing, least semilattice pinning followed by majority/minority factorization decides explicit table CSP in polynomial time.
construct.scope: Boolean explicit tables, one supplied AND/OR/MAJ/XOR type per variable, checked closure.
construct.derivation: Use f(x,x,f(y,y,x)) to preserve non-H coordinates under least H pin; f(x,x,y) factors M/A; solve 2SAT and affine systems.
